case: If you believe Robinson's growing role in the passing game will lift him above a weak Falcons offense, this swap can work, but I'd lean against it. This week's chart is missing, so the call comes down to the sheet and your gut. Gibbs is the RB1 on the season and runs behind one of the league's better offenses. Robinson has slipped to RB16 over the last month, though his snaps and targets are climbing, and he has historically picked up after midseason. You're in a playoff spot and need points now, so trading the surer producer on a hope of a rebound is a risk I'd only take if you really love Bijan.

sides.reason: Bijan Robinson, a busy back whose passing role is growing.
